decision.what: 0.13.0: preconditioner='auto' is near at every size where the core links MUMPS; near_factorization='auto' is MUMPS where linked, SuperLU otherwise; with SuperLU, auto keeps block from AUTO_BLOCK_FROM_UNKNOWNS = 400,000; MUMPS without L0 tree parallelism (ICNTL(48)=0) on one thread unless near_factor_threads; bit-identical results promised only at the same thread counts
